development_validation.status: Exposed in v1; diagnostic only, never an independent claim
development_validation.arms: base_zero_v3, base_fewshot_v3 (training example scale-seed-dev2-01, v3 reference), every trained v3 adapter
development_validation.decoding: v3 prompt, greedy, max 1600 new tokens, 4096 total, BF16 autocast, no grammar/repair/retry/truncation
development_validation.scoring: relation_contract_v3 strict units; per arm deduplicated 6 tasks + 18 contents; core and layout separate

sealed_holdout.opening_gate: Only after development evaluation and its verification are COMPLETE; opened once; never rerun
sealed_holdout.arms: same v3 arms plus v1 large_28 adapter under its frozen v2 prompt (cross-version reference)
sealed_holdout.primary: core content exact /18, task exact /6, both sides exact /18, strict unit precision/recall
sealed_holdout.secondary: claims-excluded unit precision/recall for v1-vs-v3, contract validity, attribution categories
sealed_holdout.v1_adaptation: v2-valid output gets claims=[]; v1 cannot earn claims units, so claims-excluded metrics are reported
sealed_holdout.after_opening: No retraining, prompt change or selection on holdout results; any new method needs a new version and new holdout
